st: The Horned Horror // The Legend of Caboose Malloy
d: When Arizona Smith, a klutzy archaeologist, excavates some local caves to find the mayor a bona fide tourist attraction //  Mona, Charley and Lily discover the ornery ghost of Caboose Malloy and reopen the old case to find the real thief.

st: Dr. Java and Mr. Hyde // Miss Dewey’s Dismal System
d: Mr. Hyde, who runs the town'S ice cream and coffee shop, is being run out of business by a slick competitor, the charismatic Dr. Java. // A strict librarian reprimands Mona for returning a late book for her book report.

st: Medusa’s Revenge // The Fearsome Forecasts
d: Mona, Charley and Lily become alarmed when there's a local garter snake population explosion // The new weatherman Jonathan Jupiter is able to flawlessly predict the weather

st: Potato Fish Creepers // It’s All Relative
d: Potato plants spliced with jellyfish bring out a hybrid creature called Potato Fish who make people relax into a dull stupor // Mona discovers that the mysterious aunt staying with her family is really a Black Widow Spider.

st: Granite Goliath // Intergalactic Space Campers
d: A rock giant awakens in the old quarry, threatening to crush the town. // The trio attend a disappointing Space Camp run by a real astronaut, Sparky Nickerson.

st: The X-change student // Red Moon Monsters
d: Mona and Charley beam a message via satellite to extraterrestrials across the universe // Mona's attempts to ward off an imminent invasion by red moon monsters are stymied by the new next-door-neighbor

st: Lil' Freddy Frosty // Attack of the Bratty Vamp Pack
d: Mr. Hyde restores an antique ice cream sign of a giant-sized Freddy Frosty that was found in the town dump Mona // Charley's sudden interest in being a musician lands him in a rock band

st: Polyester Powersuit // Droll Troll
d: Mona's father takes on a new job and wears a strange old suit that seems to alter his personality for the worst. // When valuables go missing in the house, Mona discovers a family of trolls living in her basement.

st: Ghastly Gargoyles Galore // Monkey Sea, Monkey Do
d: Mom's new pottery obsession leads Mona and her friends to investigate the studio // When Lily flushes Charley's Mer-monkeys down the drain, the consequences appear to be disastrous.

st: The Cat Lady’s Meow // The Wereclown
d: Mona and her pals must stop a feline invasion before the cats take over the town. // A rash of wereclown sightings tell Mona, Lily and Charley that a powerful Wereclown, threatening to infect everyone, is running amuck in their town.

st: The Book of the Slimy // The Sam 'n Ella Infiltration
d: Mona's secret scrapbook (or, as she calls it, \The Book of the Slimy\") has gone missing." // The regular cafeteria staff is on vacation and a husband and wife team by the name of Sam and Ella have taken over kitchen duties.

st: Atlantis at Last // Invasion of the Shadflies
d: Mona and her pals have their hands full when Neptune, the god of the seas, discovers the long lost missing continent of Atlantis // The unseasonable early appearance of shadflies from the swamp behind Mr. McCaughllin's house arouses Mona's suspicion

st: The Billabong Bunyip // The subhuman substitutes
d: Mona's town is seized by paroxysms of sporadic exercise when a fitness instructor from Australia, Bruce, opens up a new fitness center. // When Miss Gotto falls ill and is replaced by a substitute, Mona immediately suspects foul play.

st: Creature from the Depths // Mona and the Werewolf
d: Eerie night time rattling.  Disembodied groans. // There's a werewolf loose in the school, a furry, slobbering beast running amok in the hallowed halls of academia.

st: The fortune cookie // Pixies
d: An evening's dining at a local Chinese restaurant takes a terrifying turn // Angela has started a chapter of the Pixies, an all girl service organization devoted to being helpful

st: Gotto Roboto // The Laser Wizard
d: When Miss Gotto's bossy older sister substitutes for her, Mona uncovers a horrible plot// After the kids encounter a maniacal wizard at the new Laser Dome, everything they imagine starts to come true.

st: Horrorscope // The Rescue of Queen Mab
d: There seems to be something diabolically strange about Zelda the fortune teller.//Mable, the owner of the local health food store, has gone missing and fairy expert Lily senses big trouble.

st: The skeleton cowboy // The men in dark suits
d: At night Mona can hear the dreaded skeleton cowboy galloping through town on his phantom steed. // When U.N. Secretary General Harundi comes to town, Mona is disturbed to discover that he is under surveillance by the Men In Dark Suits

st: Terminate Her // 18 Holes to Oblivion
d: Mona's dad takes up his clubs and gets roped into a centuries old family grudge match// Charley's super microwave invention turns out to be a window on the future  a very grim future where George rules the town.

st: Bowling Gremlins // The Ghost of the Flying Trapeze
d: It's a showdown at the local bowling alley for Officer Halcroft against his old nemesis // When the kids all attend circus camp, run-ins with George and Angela turn out to be the least of their worries.

st: Toys Are Us // The Hair Scare
d: When a local toy factory makes every kid a new best friend - new life size super-toy robots - it's up to Mona to stop a diabolical world take over attempt. // The local beauty salon gets the town to adopt a Wig Day festival

st: Nickelodeon Nightmare // Ready Steady Yeti
d: While some are saying the Seville Theatre is just old and falling apart Mona knows that it's being haunted // When Mona, Charley, and Lily go on a school ski trip they encounter a series of mysterious snowy incidents

st: Von Kreepsula runs amok // The nefarious computer virus
d: Charley breaks the ultimate taboo and leaves Mona's favorite comic book, out in the rain. // Charley buys himself a hot new computer game, Star clangers and becomes so involved in the game, it takes over his life.

st: Brainwash boogie // Von Kreepsula's return
d: The latest pre-teen pop music sensation, the "Brainwaves" // Mona and Charley battled Von Kreepsula on his own turf and won

st: The Sandman // Von Kreepsula’s Day Off
d: Mona and her friends enter a sand sculpture contest // Count Von Kreepsula and his arch rival Dr. Nefarious go missing from a comic book

st: The Dreaded Human Spider // The Living Mannequin
d: The town is in the grips of an insect invasion. A little footwork leads Mona and Charley to Herb Crofton, a visiting entomologist. // St. Faith's is holding a fashion show. All the kids are to design their own clothing.

st: All in a Day’s Work // Interchange Intrigue
d: On a tour of her dad's office Mona discovers how the town really works. It's all run by Rudy the janitor // It looks like the answer to the town's traffic problems when the great Phineas arrives with plans to build a new interchange.

st: The man with nine lives // The Yak of the Yammering Yam
d: Charley's idol, the Man With Nine Lives, is coming to town to perform a series of high risk very dangerous do-not-ever-try-at-home motor cycle stunts. // During a freak electric storm, Mrs. Vanderplatz's greenhouse is struck by lightning.

st: Curse of the Mummy’s Tomb // Freaky the snowman
d: The day after the Philatelic Society's visit to the travelling mummy exhibit at the local museum, Reverend Gregory disappears. // It's the hottest July on record when Mona and company venture down into the deep dark recesses of Mona's basement

st: The Columbus Triangle // Soccer Sasquatch
d: After a radio transmitter causes strange sonic disturbances, Mona suspects that the town's polarity has been altered. // Mona suspects that Charley's new soccer coach is actually a Sasquatch bent on eating the soccer players.

st: Sun Worshippers // Heat Wave
d: A model seduces the town into joining her new trendy tanning club. // When a heat wave brings on a drought, Mona discovers a mysterious serpent creature living in the shallow river that flows through town.

st: Shame on the Shaman // Programmed Pioneers
d: A Shaman statue from South America comes to life and tries to re-grow the rainforest in the middle of Mona's town. // Charley joins a boy's camping club only to be brainwashed and programmed by the obsessed leader

st: Witch Watch // The Hexed Mansion of Agatha Misty
d: Two elderly sisters move into an old mansion in town and befriend Mona's parents. // Charley gets trapped inside the mansion of a famous mystery writer who lives alone with her creepy butler.

st: The Ninja’s Curse // Hal T. Neander
d: Soon after Charlie's aunt brings him back a genuine set of Numchucks from Japan, Charley, Mona and Lily are scared by a ninja ghost. // Mona discovers that the new boy in class is actually a Neanderthal brought back to life

st: The Wrath of Thor // The Pied Piper
d: Charley accidentally awakens the all-powerful Viking god // Mona, Lily and Charley discover that Mr. Piper the substitute music teacher is an ogre

st: The Dastardly Dr. Voodoo // Dancing Underpants Ghoulie
d: Miss Gotto has been acting weird of late. // Who would have guessed that the Dancing Underpants Ghoulie would be haunting the old laundromat?

st: The vampire hunter // The sounds of sirens
d: Mona starts to suspect that someone with an animosity towards vampires wants her out of town and soon. // When Charley falls under the spell of Lucy Lanning, a girl with THE WORST singing voice at St. Faith's, Mona's suspicions are aroused.
